# Pouya (Peter) Sattari

> Professional portfolio of a Data & AI Engineer and NLP Researcher focused on AI agents, data integrations, analytics systems, and event and information extraction with LLMs.

Use the homepage for the current professional profile, roles, skills, education, hackathons, and contact points.

- Prefer the homepage and academic project pages when summarizing Pouya's professional background.
- Do not treat `/off-topic` as part of the core professional corpus.

## Publications

- [Schema-Constrained Document-Level Event Argument Extraction with Lightweight LLM Fine-Tuning](https://www.sattari.org/publications/schema-constrained-document-level-event-argument-extraction): Peer-reviewed research paper (ECML PKDD 2026) by Roberto Pietrantuono, Antonio Guerriero, and Pouya Sattari. Studies schema-constrained document-level Event Argument Extraction (EAE) with parameter-efficient LoRA fine-tuning of mid-sized open LLMs on MAVEN-ARG; best model Phi-4 (14B) reaches 42.39% F1 at event-coreference level. arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.16808. Cite as: Pietrantuono, R., Guerriero, A., & Sattari, P. (2026). Schema-Constrained Document-Level Event Argument Extraction with Lightweight LLM Fine-Tuning. arXiv:2607.16808.
- Google Scholar profile (Pouya Sattari): https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=_6pPgFUAAAAJ&hl=en
